column1: # The tax on a portfolio account's capital gains
# Every row is reviewed like code and cites where the rate is enacted.
# `tradeline.tax` reads this file; its location is `tax.schedule` in
# tradeline.toml. A rate is in force from `in_force_from` (a transfer date)
# until the item's next row. A Protocol freezes the rates in force on its
# freeze day and applies them to every event (docs/risk-controls.md
# (portfolio families)"). `item` is one of:
#   short_term   a fraction of a short-term gain on listed equity sold through
#                the exchange with STT paid (held twelve months or less)
#   long_term    a fraction of a long-term gain on it (held more than twelve months)
#   cess         Health and Education Cess
# Surcharge is not modelled and the Rs 1.25 lakh long-term exemption is not
# applied; dividends are taxed at `tax.dividend_rate`
# The file starts on 2018-04-01
